verdict.rationale: Data region or residency choice is a fair axis for a SaaS incident-management platform, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents selectable storage regions or residency controls. The only location-related detail is a single API host, api.incident.io, which says nothing about where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
